newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Amsterdam police don skates in crime crack-down.
newsitem.headline: Amsterdam police don skates in crime crack-down.

text.p: Amsterdam's police force plans to become the first in the world to use roller skates in its relentless pursuit of law-breakers.
Starting this summer, a team of six officers on skates will patrol the Dutch city's pedestrian zones and the narrow streets of the tourist district.
A police spokesman said the roller patrols would give officers greater mobility in cracking down on pick-pockets and shop-lifters.
"Police officers on skates are very fast and we hope to catch many more street thieves," spokesman Klaas Wilting said.
Tests were now being carried out to find the most suitable type of skate, he added.
